visualCharacteristics.layout: single-column stacked list, image ~45% left, text right
visualCharacteristics.notes: black rows with 1px grey border, white underlined title link and underlined bold 'Explore All Articles' link

contentPattern.structure: 2 columns, one row per topic. Cell 1 = landscape photo; Cell 2 = H3 heading containing the topic link, description paragraph, and a final link-only paragraph (e.g. 'Explore All Articles', may be bold). Items stack image-on-top on mobile and image-left (~45%) / text-right from 600px
